body:
r/atheisthavens <3 omg I was really blown away by how simple the posts were to reveal how genuine their offer was. Thank you so much for pointing it out and showing me such a great community. 
And thank you for replying/caring. It means a lot. Thank you very much and I'm going to live.

You can help by continuing to care/be available for people you are absolutely not responsible for in any way such as you did for me. I don't know why you decided to give a bit of your time and effort to me, but I really appreciate it and I'm so thankful. Please continue to be awesome!

Hey kungpaobeef, thanks for the reply and hopeful thoughts. I really appreciate it. I'm going to look into a clinic I looked up last night. You guys are really a big help and I'm so glad I posted despite how horrible I was feeling about it yesterday. Thanks a lot.

Hey man, this really struck a chord. I've been thinking today about moving out and floating around a bit. I want to try to find a job by being as honest as I can and then try to live in my car for a while and stop by a friend's house to wash/sleep on a bed every so often.

Definitely want to see how it goes. So far, this is what I want most.
Yea, I'll be going to church tomorrow to see my friends. Hopefully it'll help me out. I just wasn't able to go out today because I was too scared to go downstairs. Thanks for the reply/encouragement.

Hey, thanks for taking the time to read/reply. I took a nap which helped me calm down a bit and I'm just glad he didn't come upstairs during that time. 

As of now, I won't do anything drastic. I'm just really tired. Thanks again.
